research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Yuga Labs is researching blockchain-based protocols for metadata linkage control, as described in the work on cryptographic containers and on-chain modules. The focus includes systems and methods for responding to disruptions in on-chain metadata linkage, confirming speculative on-chain module linkages, and enhancing autonomy in blockchain environments. These efforts highlight Yuga Labs’ development in secure and resilient NFT and digital collectible infrastructure.

Yuga Labs is a blockchain technology company that develops NFTs and digital collectibles. It specializes in the fields of blockchain, cryptocurrency, and digital media.

Yuga Labs was founded in 2021 by Wylie Aronow and Greg Solano and headquartered in Miami, Florida.

press_references.value: Bored Ape Yacht Club maker Yuga Labs settles with 'expressive appropriation artist' Ryder Ripps in long-running trademark case

legal_proceedings.description: Yuga Labs settled its trademark lawsuit against conceptual artist Ryder Ripps and his business partner Jeremy Cahen over a copycat Bored Ape Yacht Club NFT collection, with Ripps barred from using Yuga's imagery and trademarks going forward.

press_references.value: Judge tosses lawsuit against Yuga Labs over failure to satisfy Howey test

legal_proceedings.description: A U.S. federal judge dismissed an investor lawsuit against Yuga Labs, finding BAYC NFTs and ApeCoin did not meet the Howey test for securities, citing lack of a common enterprise and no explicit profit promises.

press_references.value: US appeals court overturns Yuga Labs’ $9M win against Ryder Ripps

legal_proceedings.description: A US appeals court overturned a $9 million judgment previously awarded to Yuga Labs in its trademark lawsuit against Ryder Ripps and Jeremy Cahen, sending the case back to a California federal court for trial on trademark infringement and cybersquatting claims.

press_references.value: NFT trader sells CryptoPunk after a year for nearly $10M loss

legal_proceedings.description: The US Securities and Exchange Commission closed its three-year investigation into Yuga Labs, which was initiated to probe NFT creators and marketplaces for potential securities violations.

press_references.value: Crypto sleuth ZachXBT says wrong suspect detained in Bored Ape NFT theft

legal_proceedings.description: Law enforcement mistakenly detained Sam Curry, a former Yuga Labs security researcher, as a suspect in the 2022 Bored Ape Yacht Club NFT theft, based on flawed evidence. The real perpetrator remains unidentified, and the investigation is ongoing.
